name: heretic
description: Training-free language model modification: Remove censorship, suppress slop, reduce sycophancy, and more
one_liner: A tool that strips the built-in 'safety' filters and overly-agreeable personality out of an open AI model, without needing to retrain it.
buyer: A niche AI hobbyist, researcher, or builder of an adult/uncensored chatbot product who specifically wants a model that won't refuse or over-hedge its answers.
business_use_cases: A roleplay/companion-app startup uses it to produce a less restrictive base model for a product whose entire pitch is a model that doesn't constantly refuse.
An AI red-team/security researcher uses it to study exactly how safety training affects model behavior, for academic or vendor-advisory work.
A model fine-tuning marketplace sells 'de-sycophanted' variants of popular open models to developers frustrated with models that always agree with the user.

money_ideas.idea: Sell access to pre-modified model checkpoints (hosted inference) for builders who don't want to run the modification themselves.

steal_this: This is a legitimately dual-use tool — the honest 'steal this' is a paid consulting service helping niche AI apps pick and tune the right open model for their use case, not a mass-market product.
